name: Jerusalem artichoke
description: Knobbly sweet tuber, unrelated to the artichoke — famous for the wind it causes.

tcm.note: A new-world tuber with no classical entry.

ayurveda.note: Read as shita and heavy; strongly vata-provoking.

histamine.note: Low for histamine. Its inulin content is a FODMAP problem, not a histamine one.
